selection: Official San Joaquin 5SI regional precipitation chosen by geography and complete 2000–2025 winter record, before any runoff join or fit. HNT is a geographically appropriate local diagnostic but lacks valid daily coverage in2013/2023.
primary: CDEC5SI monthly sensor2 durationM, sum October through March, inches converted to mm by25.4
quality: All six monthly values must be finite nonnegative and blank/r flag; r revised values retained and counted. No imputation.
local_rain: HNT daily sensor45; sum unflagged nonnegative Oct–Mar daily readings when>=90% calendar coverage, otherwise missing; no scaling or imputation.
ground_snow: HNT daily sensor3; latest finite nonnegative unflagged measurement in March29–31; negative SWE is missing, never zero.
availability: Apr1 is an assumed forecast issue. Current CDEC archive DATE TIME/OBS DATE are period/observation labels, not publication times. Exact original publication or revision times have not been reconstructed. Optional Oct–Feb precipitation is provided for conservative lag sensitivity.
regional_vs_basin: 5SI contains CalaverasBigTrees,HetchHetchy,Yosemite,NorthFork,Huntington; broader than Friant upstream catchment. Ground HNT station at37.227570,-119.220482,7000ft is inside upstream basin.
basin: USGS NLDI full upstream basin forUSGS-11251000 SanJoaquinbelowFriant; full catchments because splitCatchment=true returned502. Geodesic1679.1124squaremiles versuspublished1676 (~0.186% larger).
